scope: Lane B public-source intake: five reviewed standalone adapters plus one blocked competition source; six heavyweight exclusions include that same Advit source (11 unique repositories).
selection_basis: Port feasibility under Python 3.12 stdlib, single file <=200KB, 10ms including IPC
Policy-family diversity and correct game/player-count mapping
Clear code and asset reuse scope
Evidence quality; GitHub stars and author win claims are not rankings

target.byte_limit_note: 200KB ceiling stated by rules; use conservative 200,000-byte local intake ceiling.

provenance_notes: Pins are exact repository revisions recorded during read-only source inspection.
Framework exclusions were inspected by research_bot_frameworks; policy candidates by public_bot_candidates.
Source claims are separate from adapter execution evidence. Local adapters link to the manifest's retained timing history; no winner is selected.
All ranking claims are author-reported unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Preserve upstream license notices with any substantial copied code. Asset permission is assessed separately from source-code permission.

performance.claim: Reference implementation; no independently verified result for this policy.

limitations: Fixed seat-number-to-position map.
Unraised preflop opening branch requires call_chips == 0, which mishandles ordinary blind-facing opens.
Postflop value signal is only whether a hole-card rank pairs the board; overpairs, straights and flushes may be missed.
Passing a 10ms deadline to the original function triggers automatic check/fold.
